interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to designate safe crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at potential crossing points to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for protected bike lanes or wider buffers.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscape buffer or street furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: High-visibility mid-block crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Road Diet
interventions.description: Add lane markings to organize traffic flow and potentially narrow travel lanes to naturally reduce vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Adding a marked mid-block crossing with high-visibility paint and signage would provide a designated safe space for pedestrians to cross.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Mark a mid-block crossing with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk at Driveway
interventions.description: Reconstruct the driveway entrance to maintain the sidewalk's level and material, signaling to drivers that they are crossing a pedestrian space and must yield.

interventions.title: High-visibility midblock crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with signage to provide a safe and legal crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-scale lighting
interventions.description: Add street-level lighting poles to improve visibility and security for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number or width of travel lanes to slow traffic and potentially add bike lanes.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install a row of street trees or large planters along the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-Block Crossing
interventions.description: Given the high-density residential use, a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage could improve connectivity and safety.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a raised median refuge to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lanes
interventions.description: Repurpose a portion of the wide roadway for protected bike lanes, providing a physical buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Midblock Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a raised pedestrian refuge island in the center median to reduce crossing distance and exposure.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Narrow the travel lanes or use physical vertical elements in the median to naturally slow vehicle speeds through the corridor.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Planting Zone
interventions.description: Install a dedicated buffer zone with trees, planters, or street furniture to provide physical and psychological separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes are high due to the residence hall, install a high-visibility mid-block crosswalk with appropriate signage.

interventions.title: Work Zone Pedestrian Management
interventions.description: Ensure a clear, ADA-compliant path is maintained through or around the construction site on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signalized mid-block crossing to provide a protected phase for pedestrians to cross the high-volume roadway.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Establish a temporary, ADA-compliant walkway in the roadway protected by physical barriers (e.g., water-filled K-rails).

interventions.title: Pedestrian Detour Signage
interventions.description: Install clear signage directing pedestrians to safe crossing points or alternative routes before they reach the obstruction.

interventions.title: Construction Zone Pedestrian Management
interventions.description: Ensure a clear, ADA-compliant path is maintained through construction zones, using temporary barriers if necessary to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.
